name: Ethan Hayes
bio:
Ethan Hayes is a seasoned chief engineer with a decade of experience in motorsport. He found his passion for racing early, spending countless hours tinkering with engines alongside his father, a local mechanic. This hands-on experience fueled his desire to pursue a career in motorsport engineering, leading him to earn a degree in mechanical engineering with a specialization in automotive design.

Ethan's approach to engineering blends technical expertise with a big-picture perspective. He believes in fostering a collaborative environment where every team member feels empowered to contribute their best. His dedication to data-driven decision-making, coupled with his ability to identify innovative solutions, has earned him a reputation as a reliable and effective leader. At Praga Racing, he aims to optimize vehicle performance and reliability through meticulous analysis and continuous improvement, ensuring the team remains competitive on the track.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave.
physical.description: Ethan is of average height with a lean build and a perpetually focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with engineering calculations and observations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Insists on personally inspecting every major component before a race.
